signature: “Ferdinandus Weißer machts in Franckenberg A 1743”; owner or repairman’s mark, “G.F.O. 1793”.
literature: Epstein and Scheyer 1932: 43, Tafel 7 (photo); Waterhouse 1993: 423; Herbert 2004.
remarks: Collection in Breslau (now Wroclaw, Poland) missing during World War II. This is the only known instrument by Weißer.
